scenario: Sammy is a 27-year-old early-career entrepreneur based in Durham. He recently left his marketing role to pursue a product idea and needs AI-assisted prototyping to test MVPs quickly without hiring developers.
expectations: Affordable, high-speed learning with real product outcomes
Supportive community of builders and mentors
Clear path from idea to launch-ready prototype

phases.title: Phase 1 | Awareness
actions: Sees a LinkedIn post showcasing a student’s Vibe Coding project.
Reads about the NC State course on Product Hunt.
Joins an entrepreneurship Slack where peers mention the program.
pains: Struggles to keep momentum when projects stall at idea stage.

feelings.quote: If I can build it myself, I can finally launch faster.

opportunities: Offer a pre-course mini challenge: build your first demo in one hour.

phases.title: Phase 2 | Consideration
actions: Compares the course to private accelerators and bootcamps.
Downloads the syllabus highlighting 90-minute sprint builds.
Emails NC State about IP rights for student projects.
pains: Worried about university bureaucracy slowing him down.
Unsure if AI tools can produce production-quality demos.

feelings.quote: I need to know this course runs like a startup, not a classroom.

opportunities: Highlight fast iteration cycles and real-world product launches.
Showcase alumni who used course prototypes to secure funding.

phases.title: Phase 3 | Enrollment
actions: Registers online and sets up project workspace.
Joins the course’s startup community group.
Selects an idea for validation in Week 1.
pains: Initial confusion during AI tool setup.

feelings.quote: Let’s see if I can pull this off solo.

opportunities: Offer quickstart templates for web app projects.
Provide peer feedback loops to simulate incubator dynamics.

phases.title: Phase 4 | Engagement
actions: Builds, tests, and refines an MVP using AI-assisted workflows.
Creates a product page with demo video and metrics.
Shares link in his pitch deck to attract seed interest.
pains: Occasional AI hallucinations causing coding issues.

feelings.quote: This course gave me the leverage to compete as a solo founder.

opportunities: Invite him to NC State’s startup showcase.
Offer alumni mentor pairing for post-course growth.
